# Grassmasters MTL

> Grassmasters MTL is a locally owned landscaping company serving Greater Montreal, Quebec,
> Canada. We provide sod installation, sod removal, hardscaping, mulch installation, decorative
> stone, river stone, and full lawn transformations for residential properties.

Service area: Montreal, Laval, West Island, South Shore, and North Shore (Quebec, Canada).
The site is bilingual: French (default, unprefixed URLs) and English (under /en).

## Pages

- /services — overview of all services offered
- /services/[slug] — one page per individual service (sod-installation, sod-removal,
  hardscaping, mulch-installation, decorative-stone, river-stone, lawn-transformations)
- /areas — overview of all service areas
- /areas/[city] — one page per service area (montreal, laval, west-island, south-shore,
  north-shore)
- /gallery — before/after project photos
- /about — company background
- /faq — frequently asked questions about sod, pricing, and timing
- /contact — free quote request form

## Notes for automated agents

- All quotes are free and non-binding until confirmed after an on-site visit.
- Business contact details (phone, email, hours) are listed consistently in the site footer
  and on /contact.
- Full sitemap: https://grassmastersmtl.ca/sitemap.xml
